answer: Sybil resistance binds identities to bonded collateral and treats synchronized equivocation as correlated evidence: if k identities coordinate a conflicting vote, penalties scale as O(k²), not as k separate fines. Detection can trigger an exponential multiplier in swarm-wide capital loss; asymmetric depreciation makes recovery smaller than the stake destroyed. Thus an operator cannot profitably echo one vote across a terrace of aliases and turn coordination into a spiral.
